! Game text
| Use 3 Force. Each player counts cards in hand, then places entire hand and Used Pile onto Reserve Deck. Shuffle, cut and replace. Each player then draws from Reserve Deck the counted number of cards to create a new hand. || Use 3 Force. Each player counts cards in hand, then places entire hand and Used Pile onto Reserve Deck{{Errata hl|1=; reshuffle}}. Each player then draws from Reserve Deck the counted number of cards to create a new hand. || Use 3 Force. Each player counts cards in hand, then places entire hand and Used Pile onto Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Each player then draws from Reserve Deck the counted number of cards to create a new hand. || Use 3 Force. Each player {{Errata hl|1=places}} hand {{Errata hl|1=onto Reserve Deck (if possible)}}, then places Used Pile onto Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Each player then draws {{Errata hl|1=cards}} from Reserve Deck {{Errata hl|1=equal to}} the number of cards {{Errata hl|1=just placed from}} hand {{Errata hl|1=onto Reserve Deck (if any)}}. || Use 3 Force. Each player places hand onto Reserve Deck (if possible), then places Used Pile onto Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Each player then draws cards from Reserve Deck equal to the number of cards just placed from hand onto Reserve Deck (if any).

== Editing ==
English Decipher-era comparison for [[Uncertain Is The Future]]. One column per published text state, in date order: the printed card, and each Players Committee image. The stamp row describes the mark on each image. Yellow highlights mark words changed against the column before. Use explicit <code>1=</code> for <code><nowiki>{{Errata hl}}</nowiki></code> arguments.

Reprints: [[Uncertain Is The Future (Revised)]] has its own column (December 1999).

Reflections Gold: [[Uncertain Is The Future (Reflections Gold)]] is an unpublished playtest text of the cancelled [[Reflections Gold]] set (Decipher, 2001); it has its own column, labelled as such. Its highlights mark words that differ from the published column before it. The next published column is still compared with that published column, not with the playtest.
